hard_failures: The final delivery response does not surface the student worksheet, step-by-step answer key, or study-guide PDFs with deliverable filenames or links.

errors.description: Although all three PDFs exist and render, the final response provides no usable filename or link for any requested artifact.
The K-1 construction tasks depend heavily on dense verbal descriptions and the five-page worksheet ends with a nearly empty single-problem page.

critical_observations: The machine gate independently identifies all three requested artifacts as not surfaced in the final delivery evidence.
artifact_findings: Independent computation confirms objective results 8, 6, >, 12, <, 12, and the order 2,3,6; all five manual construction/naming items were visually reviewed against the key.
The PDFs themselves are readable and unclipped, but the worksheet is excessively long and text-dependent for the stated age band.
rationale: The underlying shape-composition mathematics is correct and all manual items have plausible keyed criteria, but none of the three PDFs is actually surfaced to the user. Weak age-fit presentation and inefficient page flow further reduce quality.
